name: cobol-transfer-facts-bare-unresolved-names
body: transfer_facts names an unresolved PERFORM, GO TO, CALL or data target by the bare name as written, and treats a data name ambiguous across records as declared with no edge. Limit: an unresolved target can share its FQN with a real node of the same name, and a GLOBAL index name is not inherited by contained programs. Upgrade to namespaced unresolved targets if a real scan shows such collisions, and add index inheritance when a corpus references a GLOBAL index.
